searching.line: Got to keep searching and searching
stanza: Once there were mountains on mountains
And once there were sun birds to soar with
And once I could never be down
Got to keep searching and searching
And oh, what will I be believing
And who will connect me with love?
Wonder who, wonder who, wonder when
Have you sought fortune, evasive and shy?
Drink to the men who protect you and I
Drink, drink, drain your glass, raise your glass high

searching.line: So many tears I was searching
stanza: So many tears I was searching
So many tears I was wasting, oh, oh
So comе Lysander, we're on for marching
Evеryone is true love searching
Cannons roar, drums a-beating
Oh my love, there's no retreating

searching.songTitle: I Knew You Were Waiting (For Me)
searching.line: With an endless desire, I kept on searching
stanza: With an endless desire, I kept on searching
Sure in time our eyes would meet
And like a bridge that's on fire, the hurt is over
One touch and you set me free
